en.text: "Doesn't this vegetarian restaurant look good? Let’s try it today!" "I'm in the mood for meat, though." "But didn’t we have yakiniku yesterday?" "Yesterday was yesterday; today is today. Besides, I could eat meat every day." "Forget it. I'll ask someone else. See you later."
